sdks.name: hms_sdk
sdks._comment: Huawei Mobile Services support, built like desktop_sdk (SDK module, not productFlavors). Dart-side: DeviceServices ({gms, hms, neither} detection, cached, fail-open to gms) and an order-30 boot hook that, ONLY on GMS-free HMS-capable devices, boots Push Kit and registers the HMS push token through the same api.user.register_device_token gateway cmd the FCM token uses (provider 'hms'). No installs - the BUILD_HMS-gated AGConnect Gradle wiring lives statically in core's android template, default-off. Strict no-op in every plain GMS build.

_host_routes_comment: Deliberately empty, declared explicitly (supacharge precedent): paas_manager tracks NO router copy after migration M5 - compose generates app_router.dart wholly from base_sdk's template plus each installed SDK's manifest routes. Every former host-owned route migrated to an SDK manifest (auth_sdk's login/register/reset, comms_sdk's /list-notification; the /view_map + /search_map host map pages were deleted, decision D5). Anything ADR-005-shaped a future manager feature needs goes HERE as data, never back into a tracked router file.
